items.hook: Tamil track Varuvaaiy makes history with a Grammy nomination
items.sum: The track Varuvaaiy has become the first Tamil song to earn a Grammy nomination, landing a nod in the Best Global Music Performance category at the 69th Grammy Awards. Created by Chennai-based composer-singer Devan Ekambaram and vocalist Subiksha Rangarajan, the song is a contemporary musical adaptation of a devotional poem by Bharathiyar. This achievement marks India's sole nomination at the 2027 awards. Devan Ekambaram noted, I'm now a Grammy nominee for life. That title can never be taken away from me.
